title: Descendants of the Great Bandits
summary: Ye Fan comes out of the cursed gallery alive with the evil source, and Elder Li of Yaoguang praises his nerve, then decides that since he is a cultivator he must survive a Four Poles strike or be crippled and kept mining. Jiang Yi, ninth of the 13 Great Bandits and a Jiang family deserter, raids the mine; Yaoguang's Supreme Elders join the fight, and Jiang Yi answers with the Jiang family's Eight Gods Brutal Force. In the chaos Ye Fan slips into the resource warehouse with the Void technique, planning to use its source to reach the Dao Palace, and runs into Tu Fei, a Dao Palace cultivator and grandson of Tu Tian, seventh of the 13 Great Bandits, who swallows the whole warehouse with his imitation Heaven-Swallowing Demon Pot. Tu Fei smells a familiar scent on Ye Fan's bottle and finds Yao Xi's handkerchief, the Yaoguang Holy Maiden's legendary love token, and is heartbroken that someone beat him to it. As Yaoguang disciples close in, the two flee together, Yao Xi turns up furious at Ye Fan, Tu Fei demands to know why she gave the token to Ye Fan and not him, and a Yaoguang Great Elder arrives.
